analysis: Examined all units. The only production-code change is LaunchAgent.swift (head lines 265-266, 268, 288-289), which adds EngineV2Factory.prefillChunkKey and stepTokenBudgetKey to inferencePassthroughEnvKeys. These are copied from the installing shell into the launchd plist EnvironmentVariables only when non-empty. The values are numeric scheduler-geometry tuning knobs (512/2048 rollback). They follow the same pattern as existing allowlisted knobs (maxPartialPrefillsKey, PrefillDeadlineMode). They carry no secrets, do not touch attestation or App Attest worker selection (the worker opt-in is still gated separately at lines 334-338 to exact '1'), and do not change the prefix-cache crypto, HMAC lookup, TTL or cache-scope controls described in T-041. The local operator already controls the plist and environment (TB-003 / ADV-001), so this adds no new privilege. The one unverified contract is how EngineV2Factory parses and bounds these env values (e.g. a huge or zero chunk size causing memory pressure or DoS). That code is not supplied and the actor is the operator, so I raise no finding; a reviewer of EngineV2Factory.prefillGeometry should confirm it validates and clamps them. The remaining units are test-only. ModelBenchmarkReportTests bumps the benchmark schema to 5 with backward-compatible decoding. ModelPrefixBenchmarkDiagnosticsTests asserts checkpointEnvironment pins the chunk and step env values. SchedulerPrefillDecisionLiveRunnerTests tests engineEnvironment geometry pinning on a synthetic GPT-OSS model. None of these affect production trust boundaries, and the benchmark fixtures use /tmp synthetic roots.
